Website Privacy

How information is handled when you visit this website.
For app privacy policies, visit each app's page.

Website hosting

This is a static website hosted on GitHub Pages. It has no custom analytics, advertising, contact forms or user accounts. It does not use custom cookies or local storage to save visitor information, or load external fonts or scripts.

Information processed by GitHub

GitHub processes connection information, including IP addresses, to deliver pages and operate the service securely. See the GitHub Privacy Statement for more information.

Contact

Posts on GitHub Issues are public. Do not post personal information. We use the information you submit to respond to your inquiry. Use our support pages for help.
